description: Fork of exp289 (dual-stream E=64 b=32 -> 1.5139). Reverts b=32 -> b=8 for fast iteration, plus two architectural changes: (1) REMOVE tok_emb_D (D-sized token embedding); x_resid initialized to zeros and only accumulates residual_lut contributions. (2) Separate UNTIED Linear(D, V) unembedder (no longer shares weights with the removed tok_emb_D). Tests whether the tied embed/unembed shortcut was actually useful or just providing redundancy. Param count roughly unchanged (~350M): -tok_emb_D (V*D=12.58M) + untied unembedder Linear (V*D=12.58M).
